lines.zh: 我贴着墙根走，躲开天光。
lines.en: I walk along the wall, away from the daylight.
Sun's coming, Death to the Demon Slayer!

lines.zh: 血镰挡在头顶，遮一点光。
lines.en: My blood scythes shield my head from the light.
In the sunlight, nowhere to hide!

lines.zh: 血镰拖地，划出一道红痕。
lines.en: His blood sickle drags, leaving a red line on the ground.
Hunched, he presses forward step by step.

lines.zh: 我蹲在屋檐下，数着脚步声。
lines.en: I crouch under the eaves, counting footsteps.

lines.zh: 他舔了舔镰刀刃上的血。
lines.en: He licks the blood off his sickle's edge.
Your blood — I'll taste it first.

lines.zh: 月光照不到的地方，归我。
lines.en: Places the moonlight can't reach belong to me.

lines.zh: 他歪头打量你身上的血。
lines.en: He tilts his head, sizing up the blood on you.

lines.zh: 我背驼着，追人却从没落下。
lines.en: My back is hunched, but I never lose a chase.

lines.zh: 血镰还在我手里，你再来。
lines.en: My blood sickle is still in my hand — come again.

lines.zh: 这点伤，舔一口血就长回来。
lines.en: A wound this small heals with a lick of blood.
My blood sickles haven't had enough!
My blood sickles are already bright.
Give me blood, give me strength!

lines.zh: 鬼杀队，今天就是你的末日！
lines.en: Demon Slayer, today is your last day!

lines.zh: 空气里有血味，还是热的那种。
lines.en: There's blood on the air, and still warm.

lines.zh: 血镰在舌尖上转了一圈。
lines.en: My blood scythe turns once on my tongue.
Poisoned blood drips off my sickle's edge.

lines.zh: 你的勇气只能延缓我的到来！
lines.en: Your courage only delays my arrival!
One sweep of my blood scythe, and the poison is in.
In the sun, you can't hide!

lines.zh: 镰刀柄抵在你脖子上，别动。
lines.en: My sickle haft is against your throat — don't move.
Avoidance is useless, I fear nothing!

lines.zh: 毒血顺着刀柄爬到你手上。
lines.en: Poison blood crawls down the haft onto your hand.
Blood scythes first, poisoned blood after.
Don't force me to use blood magic!

lines.zh: 你挡住这片阴影，正好我用。
lines.en: You're blocking this patch of shade — just what I need.

lines.zh: 别再靠近了，否则你会后悔！
lines.en: Don't get any closer, or you'll regret it!
When my blood scythe sings, run.
Toxic blood runs down my sickle.

lines.zh: 他先盯你的手腕，那里血多。
lines.en: He eyes your wrists first; the blood is thick there.
He knows that Demon Slayer uniform.

lines.zh: 他把你算进今晚的份量。
lines.en: He counts you into tonight's portion.
The blood sickle turns slightly, pointing at you.

lines.zh: 毒血在他指间凝成细线。
lines.en: Poison blood beads into threads between his fingers.
He turns the sickle slowly, waiting for you to move.
He remembers which way you dodge.
His Blood Demon Art creeps along the floor.

lines.zh: 他把你逼向无月光的角落。
lines.en: He drives you toward a corner with no moonlight.
Sweat and blood, he smells both.

lines.zh: 镰刀挂在他手指上打转。
lines.en: The sickle spins on his finger.

lines.zh: 他先废你的腿，再慢慢来。
lines.en: He'll lame your legs first, then take his time.
The alley is too narrow to dodge his sickle.

lines.zh: 他的影子罩住了你的退路。
lines.en: His shadow covers your way back.
Swinging blood scythe, blood stench rises!
Toxic blood splashes, ghostly howls echo!
Dodge under the sun, sword and blade clash!
Land of Full Moon, evil ghost awakens!
Wan Zang's blood, flows with life!
Toxic blood attacks, you can't escape!

lines.zh: 血镰横着扫来，割开空气。
lines.en: The blood sickle sweeps sideways, cutting the air.

lines.zh: 毒血溅在刀身上，冒起白烟。
lines.en: Poison blood spatters your blade and hisses white.
One kick slams you into the wall.
The sickle tip flicks your bracer aside.

lines.zh: 血鬼术的血线缠上你的脚。
lines.en: Blood threads of his art coil round your feet.

lines.zh: 他抓着你的领口举起来。
lines.en: He grabs your collar and lifts you.
This sickle swings for your knees.

lines.zh: 他拨开你的刀，笑得很难听。
lines.en: He knocks your sword aside and laughs ugly.
Appears under moonlight, evil ghost awakens!
Land of Full Moon, my homeland!
Chasing in the dark, Demon Slayers!
Wan Zang's blood, source of life!
At the alley's end, the blood sickle gleams first.
He straightens up out of the wall's shadow.

lines.zh: 毒血在砖缝间慢慢渗出。
lines.en: Poison blood seeps between the bricks.

lines.zh: 上弦之陆的名字夜里传开。
lines.en: The name of Upper Moon Six spreads through the night.

lines.zh: 陆鬼真难缠，被火烧的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Land ghost tough! — and the fire makes it worse.

lines.zh: 箭插在肩上，我笑着拔出来。
lines.en: An arrow in my shoulder — I pull it out grinning.
The spell stopped my blood sickle — again.
